description: Cards that could replace a target card, two ways. `similar`: the cards whose rules text is nearest the target's (precomputed over the whole catalogue, best first: nearest by text, with a nearer mana value, a more played card and one whose effects point at the same side ahead; `similarity` 0–1 is the text closeness alone, not a verdict), fitted to the deck when given — its colour identity (both commanders of a pair, else the target's), legal in its format, not already in it — as `owned` (the user's cards with free copies) and `to_buy` (cheapest priced printing in `currency`, null when none is priced; `owned_claimed` = copies the user owns that the decks in `claimed_by` claim in full: name them). Nearness is in the words, not in how a card plays with the deck: YOU judge which do the job, and say so. `similar.known` false means no list exists for the card yet. `candidates`: owned cards passing mechanical filters only (a shared primary type, cmc within cmc_window, default ±2, ignored for lands; optional price_ceiling per copy; with a deck, legal in its format). Both lists leave out a banned card, and a restricted one unless the row holds a single copy, since a swap keeps the row's count. Disclose free vs. claimed counts, say `proxies` beside a card that has any, and name every deck in `shared_with`. A card to buy with no price yet gets one from the nightly price refresh (`price_queued` is always false: this tool queues nothing). To make the swap, call replace_card with the row's want_id. Read-only: it changes nothing and starts no work; a target named by a name newer than the catalogue is looked up on Scryfall. Not on every plan: a PLAN_LIMIT answer says so.

currency.description: Display currency. USD/EUR come from Scryfall; CHF is always EUR × the stored ECB rate. A response that carries `rate_missing` could not price in CHF at all: tell the user that, not that the cards have no price.
